how: Members recruit people already present to make the proposed figure and call for help with a build being started.
A starter expresses feeling alone and needing helpers without establishing permanent incapacity.
Members answer proposals with bare commitments and give thanks to an offered helper.
A direct invitation receives a bare acceptance in its reply branch.
A question about unrestricted placement receives an explanation of factions and alliances as part of the activity.
An ambiguous apology does not establish withdrawal under strain or repair of a personal quarrel.
A member presents the figure they are starting without treating others' subsequent joining as part of that role.
A single proposal joins starting the figure to calling for helpers without establishing a separate interval between them.
Members report that they are working and that the placed figure remains.
Reports of joining and working cannot establish which actual placements resulted from each recruitment.
Members revise scale and shading and propose alternative figures and visual effects.
A proposal makes planned redraws a way to animate sunglasses in the timelapse.
A proposed mouth provides an easy reference point for placing.
A participant promises to pass the shared template into the counterpart's discussion server.
Reference points and template circulation do not establish that a template settled an argued design.
A new discussion server is created while important information is explicitly kept in the original thread.
A request to enter the counterpart's server receives an invitation and a builder request receives a promise to relay the template.
A discussion venue and practical guidance do not establish either decided command or its absence in unseen deliberation.
Offering a restitution script and recruiting runners precede any demonstrated execution.
The script offer establishes intended automation without demonstrating actual automated placements.
Restitution is stated as the script's purpose without establishing pixel allowance pressure as its cause.
Recruiting script runners for speed does not establish personal schedules or costs of participation.
The offered script and speed claim do not establish a site fault, faulty timer, or device problem.
Requested and explicitly offered access to a discussion server does not establish covert entry or hidden plans.
The room calls for protection against trolls altering its placed figure.
The same turn thanks collaborators and immediately calls for protecting their work.
The request to spare the damaged figure enters direct negotiation about protection and later rebuilding.
Reports of failed instructions do not establish uninformed keepers restoring a known form as the source of damage.
A denial of collective responsibility receives a public withdrawal of blame.
Attribution includes publicly withdrawing an accusation after a denial without independently verifying that denial.
Participants shrink and move the work when neighbouring uses crowd the intended space before confirmed loss.
A competing-use warning precedes a directly answering choice of a new spot.
A later rebuilding proposal claims host permission after the work is reported swallowed.
The early move answers a competing-use warning rather than explicitly attributing relocation to insufficient hands.
Participants set a limit on the figure's space and suggest talking to the neighbouring room before expanding.
Members limit the size of an effect to avoid fights.
A free-for-all challenge receives a justification of faction rules and alliances as part of the fun.
Participants ask that the figure be spared and report instructions to avoid pixel art.
A request for rebuilding after the background is finished receives an explicit promise of help.
The threatened room requests help and receives promises of later rebuilding.
Participants accept temporary destruction in exchange for promised rebuilding after the neighbouring flag expands.
Trading help includes accepting erasure now for reconstruction promised later.
Help sought under strain can yield commitments while successful delivery remains unresolved.
A negotiated channel yields a promise to relay a template without establishing that the promised builders arrived.
The counterpart explicitly pledges alliance.
Participants seek and receive access to the counterpart's coordination venue.
Alliance pledges under strain do not by themselves establish effective coordinated protection.
A participant promises to carry the template into the counterpart's discussion server.
A rebuilding proposal invokes the host's permission to build over another figure without demonstrating enforceable host control.
A collective defense decision coexists with reports that instructions cannot control all continuing destruction.
Limits are reported around protection instructions and ongoing negotiations without a refusal explicitly linked to a concluded agreement.
Agreements produce effective restraint only insofar as actual placers comply with the negotiated plan.
One negotiator sustains trust in promised help despite a directly preceding warning of internal division.
A neighbour defending the figure does not establish dual membership or feeling torn between rooms.
A joking request for a sequel receives an offer of beer as compensation for the canvas loss.
A repair appeal identifies transforming the figure into Hitler as hostile tampering without establishing a wider debate over offensive speech.
A canvas victory claim does not establish an inherited quarrel naming the rival.
The local victory claim neither establishes an inherited rivalry nor tests the cross-room claim about pre-existing ties.
A character proposal and a sequel joke do not establish an inherited running joke or ideology organising the contest.
Creating a discussion server does not establish that a new canvas-born faction formed around the figure.
A reaction to the creator's prank shares a thread with a concrete canvas invitation and an offer to help.
The separate prank exchange does not establish joking intent in the canvas invitation or parody across the whole host.
A participant's choice to retain important updates does not establish a host rule regulating canvas talk.
Recruitment and retained updates do not establish that a canvas flood caused host regulation.
Identifying trolls altering the figure does not establish that opposition to canvas posts motivated their actions.
Members announce success and praise what everyone made.
A completion claim explicitly credits the collaborators who made the figure.
Participants report the figure's final absence and explicitly mourn its loss.
Celebration precedes loss reports without showing that celebration caused recording or mourning.
A counterpart apologises for final absence and receives qualified acceptance.
Participants propose continuing friendship after the loss and qualify acceptance with an acknowledged debt.
Continued friendship carries an unpaid debt and joking compensation without completed reconstruction.
The explicit mourning song supports mourning whereas the sequel request belongs to joking compensation.
The apology joins reported loss to continued friendship without isolating recording as the cause of that wish.
A preclosure blame withdrawal and a mourning song do not establish a post-closure contest over the retained version of events.
A neighbour's apology and proposed friendship do not establish arrivals brought by seeing the mark or new ordinary participation.
Requesting a sequel from a neighbouring participant does not establish outreach to the creator or press.
A participant explicitly claims victory over the neighbouring room.
A call to fight does not establish whether the intended action attacks neighbouring artwork or resists encroachment.
The call to fight supports confrontation rather than pleading with attackers to stop.
Recruitment and fighting language do not establish that the call produced an attack on rival artwork.
Later restraint is not shown answering an unambiguous initiating attack call in its exchange.
Negotiation follows confrontation language without an explicit link making an attack call its cause.
A victory claim is visible without an explicit link showing that an attack call caused the contest in talk.
